website.note: Fulgent Genetics public site is laboratory-services oriented; no consolidated drug pipeline page. Therapeutic candidates are developed under the Fulgent Pharma subsidiary (acquired 2022; ANP Technologies fully acquired July 2025).

pipeline.modality: Nano-drug delivery formulation of paclitaxel (small molecule cytotoxic in PEOZ polymer nanoparticle)
pipeline.license_origin: Originally exclusively licensed from ANP Technologies, Inc. (June 2017); Fulgent acquired 100% of ANP in July 2025 securing full ownership of the patent estate.

indications.indication: Recurrent or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC), 2nd/3rd line, in combination with cetuximab
indications.trial_design: Phase 2, randomized, multi-center, open-label; up to 46 patients 1:1 to FID-007 75 mg/m2 + cetuximab vs FID-007 125 mg/m2 + cetuximab
indications.trial_status: Active, not recruiting (enrollment complete; preliminary data on 39 patients presented at ESMO October 2025; interim findings expected June 2026; full readout expected 2H 2027). Planned Phase 3 registrational trial in HNSCC as early as 1H 2027 via 505(b)(2) pathway.
key_milestones: Planned Phase 3 registrational initiation as early as 1H 2027

indications.indication: Advanced solid tumors (including head and neck, ampullary, pancreatic)
indications.trial_design: Phase 1/1b dose escalation and expansion in advanced solid tumors; 50 patients enrolled at US sites
indications.trial_status: Enrollment complete; manageable safety profile reported, preliminary anti-tumor activity observed; PK linear and dose-proportional, comparable to nab-paclitaxel; no neuropathy above grade 2

pipeline.modality: Nano-drug delivery formulation of SN38 (active metabolite of irinotecan; topoisomerase I inhibitor)
pipeline.license_origin: Originally exclusively licensed from ANP Technologies, Inc.; Fulgent acquired 100% of ANP in July 2025 securing full ownership of the patent estate.

indications.indication: Advanced solid tumors (preclinical efficacy shown in colon, bile duct, ovarian, pancreatic xenografts)
indications.trial_name: Study of FID-022 in Participants With Advanced Solid Tumors
indications.trial_design: Phase 1/1b safety and tolerability dose-escalation; planned enrollment 42 patients at US sites; dose-finding to determine MTD
indications.trial_status: Recruiting; first dose level completed December 2025, second dose level completed January 2026, third dose level commenced February 2026; primary completion date 2027-12-31
key_milestones: Third dose level dosing began February 2026
MTD determination targeted within next year

laboratory_services: Genetic and genomic testing (germline NGS, FulgentExome, Pipeline Manager / PLM, Ultra Rapid Whole Genome Sequencing launched 2025)

excluded_preclinical.reason: Antibody-drug conjugates using novel linker/payload platform are in preclinical development; no IND/clinical trial yet.
